actions.name: 轻柔下巴回收与点头控制
actions.phase_zh: 靠背坐位轻柔下巴回收阶段，头整体小幅后移，眼睛平视，肩部放松。
actions.pose: Gentle SEATED CHIN RETRACTION single holding phase, right-facing true side profile. She sits upright supported by a simple stable neutral-gray chair with backrest. Both feet flat on floor in white athletic shoes, knees and hips comfortably bent near 90 degrees, hands relaxed on thighs. Head translates very slightly backwards relative to neck while chin remains approximately horizontal, making a subtle small double-chin appearance, ear near above shoulder. Eyes look level forward toward image right. Do NOT bow head, do NOT tilt face down, do NOT lean head backwards. No hand touches head, no forceful chin compression. Natural relaxed jaw and shoulders, upper back supported and trunk upright. Show entire seated figure, realistic proportions, full chair and feet in frame.

actions.name: 弹力带肩外旋
actions.phase_zh: 右肩外旋阶段：右肘屈约90度贴身，右前臂温和向外转，锚点位于身体对侧。

Standing facing camera, slight 15-degree three-quarter view, feet hip-width in white athletic shoes. RIGHT upper arm stays vertical snug at her right flank (viewer LEFT), RIGHT elbow bent 90 degrees and stays directly beside right waist, optionally a thin gray towel between elbow and ribs. RIGHT forearm rotated OUTWARD toward her RIGHT side (viewer LEFT): right hand at waist/elbow height and clearly farther toward image LEFT than right elbow, modest range, wrist straight, thumb naturally upward while gripping small gray band handle. Elbow NOT pulled behind body. Neutral-gray band runs from right hand ACROSS lower front of torso to a secure fixed gray post on her LEFT side (viewer RIGHT), anchor at elbow height. Thus working right arm is AWAY from anchor side; the band pulls the hand inward while she resists outward. Anchor and relevant heavy stable base visible near RIGHT frame edge. LEFT arm hangs relaxed near left side clear of band. Chest and pelvis stay facing forward, no shoulder shrug or trunk twisting, no biceps curl, no horizontal arm spreading. Both hands and feet complete.

correction_prompts:

Image 1 is generated photograph to EDIT. Images 2–4 are original woman identity/style references.
Keep EXACT same woman, hair, clothes, body proportions, white socks, gray mat, T-shaped low raised arms, thumbs-up hands, chest and abdomen contact with mat, photographic style, camera framing and cool gray-blue backdrop. Change ONLY head/neck and towel placement.
The current towel supports her nose/mouth/cheek and forehead is hovering. Correct to a NEUTRAL prone neck with FACE aimed down at mat, FOREHEAD resting on the top of a small folded neutral-gray towel. Place the towel directly UNDER FOREHEAD above eyebrows. Forehead must have visible gentle CONTACT with towel surface. Nose and mouth MUST NOT be compressed into towel: nose and mouth extend just beyond the towel edge into an open air space so breathing is unobstructed. No cheek resting, no head turned sidewards, no chin on pad, no forehead suspended. Face partly occluded naturally by this downward pose; do not turn head to show face.
